newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures up, March S&Ps rally late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures up, March S&Ps rally late.

text.p: Jan 10 - Most U.S. stock index futures were higher, with S&Ps rallying to 766.50. Further resistance is at the one-mos high and all-time settlement high of 767.00. Traders attributed the market's reversal to heavy broad-based buying. Nikkeis had no reaction, as March remained locked limit at down 1,000.0.
